comment_regular: Verified post-load owner resolution: ExtraOwnership (type 0x27/XOWN) treats its stored dword as a FormID, rebases it with TESForm_ResolveFormID, resolves via TESForm_LookupByFormID, and replaces the slot with TESForm*. Missing owners remove the extra. ExtraGlobal (type 0x28/XGLB) follows the same path with a TESGlobal RTTI cast; missing/wrong-type globals remove their extra. ExtraRank (0x29/XRNK) is an inline signed value and is not FormID-linked.
